notes.title: Super Vili update 1.2 and price cut is up!
notes.content:
We decided to cut price of Super Vili to 0.99$ or 0.79€!

Also here are the updates for 1.2 version:

- fullscreen/windowed screen toggle with F11 key
- improved pause and other menus
- add extra sound to the winning screen after final boss
- improved sprite for helicopter
- enlarged attacking range of the final boss
- added stylish in-game mouse cursor
- mouse cursor is now hidden when playing levels

In the meantime we also made two free spin-off games from Super Vili universe, available for Android devices here:
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6429611997853742488]https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6429611997853742488[/url]
and we continue to work on Super Vili Mobile port and on updates for PC port.

Let us know your high score! :)

Happy gaming,
Affordable Care Games
